verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash offers multi-currency sub-accounts with up to 5% yield (jeeves-docs-5, jeeves-docs-38), satisfying the high-yield sub-account element, and allows manual/favorable-rate conversions between Jeeves Cash accounts (jeeves-docs-41). However, there is no evidence of configurable automated transfer rules (e.g., scheduled sweeps or threshold-based auto-funding) to build a cash cushion. Missing for 10: automated/rule-based transfer scheduling between operating and high-yield accounts, sweep triggers, or policy-based cushion automation.
